description: Source code implementing cryptographic functions related to TLS key derivation, including tls1_P_hash, CRYPTO_tls1_prf, and CRYPTO_tls13_hkdf_expand_label, with dependencies on OpenSSL libraries.

methods.name: tls1_P_hash
methods.description: Computes the TLS P_hash function as specified in RFC 5246, section 5, using HMAC with the provided hash, secret, label, and seeds, XORing the output into the provided buffer.

methods.name: CRYPTO_tls1_prf
methods.description: Implements the TLS PRF, supporting MD5/SHA1 and other hash functions, to generate key material based on secret, label, and seed.

methods.name: CRYPTO_tls13_hkdf_expand_label
methods.description: Performs HKDF expand label operation for TLS 1.3, constructing the HKDF label and calling HKDF_expand.
